newsitem.title: USA: US LPGs down amid weak NYMEX futures.
newsitem.headline: US LPGs down amid weak NYMEX futures.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices fell in moderate trade on Thursday amid weak values on NYMEX futures, players said.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, propane was down a quarter cent at between 34.75 cents and 35.00 cents a gallon. 35.125-cent deals were done.
Conway, Kansas, hub material was also weaker, down a half cent to deals done at 36.50 cents and 36.75 cents a gallon.
Belvieu normal butane came in a half cent lower at 41.00/41.25 cents.

"NYMEX is weaker and our market is pretty comfortable with the overall liquids supply picture," said a Midwest trader, noting Thursday's decline. -- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
